Position Summary

The Opportunity

Overview

Silverbrook Grain Cooperative is looking for a Business Operations Analyst to join our planning team in Regina.

Responsibilities

- Support strategic planning cycles and operational reporting
- Analyze process improvement opportunities across the supply chain
- Maintain operational dashboards for the leadership team

What You Bring

- Enrolled in a business, economics, or operations program
- Strong analytical and communication skills

Location: Regina, SK
Work Arrangement: On-site
Work Term: Summer 2028
Duration: 4 months
Salary: $25.00 per hour
Application Deadline: 2028-02-15
